11036.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
11036.blurb: Undead Argent Dawn member who helps Garek and Anya retake Dawn's Watch and destroy Naxxramas' central crystal.

7564.name: Marin Noggenfogger
7564.blurb: In Traveler: The Spiral Path he tips off Malus under blackmail; in The Goblin Way he aligns his cartel with Gazlowe's.

11832.name: Keeper Remulos
11832.blurb: In the novel Stormrage Xavius uses him as a pawn to trap Malfurion, until he is cleansed of the corruption.

7800.name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
7800.blurb: In the short story Cut Short he makes himself king of Gnomeregan, until Gelbin Mekkatorque's trap cuts him in half.

1855.name: Tirion Fordring
1855.blurb: The Silver Hand knight who frees the orc Eitrigg from execution in the novel Of Blood and Honor.

10508.name: Ras Frostwhisper
10508.blurb: Cult of the Damned mage who rose as a lich; he led the cultists out of Andorhal until Garek Bandarion cornered him.

items.13626: His head: the Cult of the Damned mage who led cultists out of Andorhal before teleporting away to Stratholme.

15990.name: Kel'Thuzad
15990.blurb: The necromancer who spread the plague and summoned Archimonde. While the phylactery lasts, he returns.

items.22520: His phylactery: the necromancer behind the plague and Archimonde's summoning returns as long as it lasts.

4454.name: Fizzle Brassbolts
4454.blurb: In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path he led a protest with Razzeric after the Annual Speedbarge Boat Race.

10429.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
10429.blurb: In the novel Beyond the Dark Portal he refuses to rejoin Ner'zhul's Horde, then falls under Nefarian's command.

items.12630: His head: the Blackhand brother who declared himself Warchief, then fell under Nefarian's command.
items.18987: His command: the Blackhand brother who refused Ner'zhul's Horde and later fell under Nefarian's command.

466.name: General Marcus Jonathan
466.blurb: Stormwind's High Commander: searches for the missing Varian in Blood of Our Fathers; defends Theramore in Tides of War.

4706.name: Razzeric
4706.blurb: In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path he pilots the speedboat Guzzler to second place, then protests the result.

12939.name: Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen
12939.blurb: In Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War he stays in Theramore and tends the injured soldiers after the Horde attacks.

5087.name: Do'gol
5087.blurb: Stonemaul ogre in the ogre village of Dustwallow Marsh, where Rexxar seeks the ogres' help in Old Hatreds.

3391.name: Gazlowe
3391.blurb: Engineer who sent Rexxar to seal the kobold dens under Orgrimmar; in The Goblin Way he strong-arms Noggenfogger.

16376.name: Craftsman Wilhelm
16376.blurb: In the novel Blood Ties he works his forge at Light's Hope Chapel, where Arator the Redeemer visits him.

928.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928.blurb: In the novel Blood Ties he is the Silver Hand lord who takes on Winthrop as his new squire.

4047.name: Zor Lonetree
4047.blurb: In the novel Stormrage Malfurion contacts him for help against the Nightmare Lord when the Emerald Nightmare strikes.

10184.name: Onyxia
10184.blurb: In the novel Beyond the Dark Portal Deathwing sends her and Nefarian to secure the Blackrock orcs as his new force.

items.18422: Her head: Deathwing's daughter, sent with Nefarian to secure the Blackrock orcs in Beyond the Dark Portal.
items.18423: Her head: Deathwing's daughter, sent with Nefarian to secure the Blackrock orcs in Beyond the Dark Portal.

11583.name: Nefarian
11583.blurb: In the novel Beyond the Dark Portal Deathwing sends him to Blackrock Spire, where he commands the Blackhand brothers.

items.19002: His head: Deathwing's eldest son, who took command of Rend and Maim Blackhand in Beyond the Dark Portal.
items.19003: His head: Deathwing's eldest son, who took command of Rend and Maim Blackhand in Beyond the Dark Portal.

10162.name: Lord Victor Nefarius
10162.blurb: The human guise of Nefarian, whom Deathwing sent to Blackrock Spire in Beyond the Dark Portal to command the Blackhands.

items.21142: A letter in the human guise of Nefarian, who took command of the Blackhand brothers in Beyond the Dark Portal.

3976.name: Scarlet Commander Mograine
3976.blurb: The Scarlet Crusade commander who led the assault on the Forsaken together with High Inquisitor Whitemane.

269127.name: Image of Archmage Modera
269127.blurb: Council of Six archmage who warned Kel'Thuzad of heresy; in the novel Stormrage she holds back the Nightmare.

3139.name: Gar'Thok
3139.blurb: Nazgrel's lieutenant who sent Rexxar to survey the border in The Founding of Durotar; the humans later raze his outpost.

3205.name: Zalazane
3205.blurb: In the short story The Judgment he is Vol'jin's childhood best friend, tested by the loa and made a witch doctor.

items.4866: His head: Vol'jin's boyhood best friend, who in the short story The Judgment became a witch doctor.

1284.name: Archbishop Benedictus
1284.blurb: In the novel The Shattering he leads the Cathedral of Light's memorial service for those who fell against the Lich King.

11833.name: Rahauro
11833.blurb: In the novel The Shattering he is Magatha Grimtotem's servant, helping her secure Thunder Bluff for the Grimtotem.

576.name: Watcher Ladimore
576.blurb: In Terror by Torchlight she commands the Night Watch and is found mortally wounded after facing the Necromancer.

2542.name: Catelyn the Blade
2542.blurb: In Quest for Pandaria she steals the Pearl of Pandaria from Li Li Stormstout to pay a debt, then gives it back.

items.4027: The troll relic blade her father Ansirem gave her. In Quest for Pandaria she steals a pearl to pay her debt.

11406.name: High Priest Rohan
11406.blurb: In the novel The Shattering he heals Anduin Wrynn and witnesses King Magni's petrification, then backs Moira Thaurissan.

1852.name: Araj the Summoner
1852.blurb: Scourge lich who commanded the Undead Ravagers in their attack on Hearthglen.

10435.name: Magistrate Barthilas
10435.blurb: In Of Blood and Honor he is Tirion Fordring's second, who oversees his prosecution and plans Eitrigg's execution.

7999.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999.blurb: Night elf Priestess of the Moon and playable hero; in Stormrage she sends Broll to search the Dream for Malfurion.

15378.name: Merithra of the Dream
15378.blurb: Ysera's child who, in The War of the Shifting Sands, charges into Ahn'Qiraj with Caelestrasz and Arygos.

8379.name: Archmage Xylem
8379.blurb: One of the randomly named enemy archmage heroes defending human bases in Stonetalon against Grom's Warsong clan.

5769.name: Hamuul Runetotem
5769.blurb: In the novel Stormrage the tauren archdruid becomes a close friend of Broll Bearmantle and is summoned to Teldrassil.

1748.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
1748.blurb: In the short story We Ride Forth the Four Horsemen confront him as the Lich King over his increasingly militant actions.

15989.name: Sapphiron
15989.blurb: The blue dragon who fought Arthas and Anub'arak over his hoard, then was raised as a Scourge frost wyrm.

10812.name: Grand Crusader Dathrohan
10812.blurb: Silver Hand knight who put his friend Tirion Fordring on trial in Of Blood and Honor; Balnazzar later took his body.

11034.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
11034.blurb: Argent Dawn leader at Dawn's Watch, which Garek, Anya and Leonid liberate from the Crushridge clan.

3387.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387.blurb: In the novel The Shattering he shelters Baine Bloodhoof and his loyal forces after Magatha seizes Thunder Bluff.

1499.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499.blurb: Brill's Forsaken magistrate; in Forsaken Kingdom his village is the first stop on Bernd's survey of the damage.

4421.name: Charlga Razorflank
4421.blurb: In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path she is said to have shaped most of the thorn dome of Razorfen Downs.

5387.name: High Explorer Magellas
5387.blurb: In the novel The Shattering he tries to decipher the Ulduar tablet and translates Magni's ritual for Anduin.

2263.name: Marshal Redpath
2263.blurb: In the novel Tides of Darkness he is Southshore's headman, who greets Anduin Lothar, Khadgar and the Stormwind refugees.

3230.name: Nazgrel
3230.blurb: Thrall's trusted advisor who asks Rexxar to stop the harpies raiding the supply caravans in The Founding of Durotar.

3916.name: Shael'dryn
3916.blurb: In the novel Stormrage the dryad warns the other guardians about the shadow attackers, then falls asleep herself.

2285.name: Count Remington Ridgewell
2285.blurb: In the novel Before the Storm he greets Fredrik Farley in Stormwind Keep and serves drinks at King Anduin's meeting.

2708.name: Archmage Malin
2708.blurb: In the novella Elegy he holds portals open at the Wizard's Sanctum for night elf refugees from Teldrassil.

1573.name: Gryth Thurden
1573.blurb: In the novel The Shattering he tells Anduin Wrynn how Moira Thaurissan had Ironforge's gryphons quarantined.

10439.name: Ramstein the Gorger
10439.blurb: Stitched Scourge abomination who stands among the undead in Stratholme as Garek Bandarion hunts Baron Rivendare.

items.15880: His head: the abomination who stood among the Scourge forces in Stratholme as Garek hunted Baron Rivendare.

15379.name: Caelestrasz
15379.blurb: Red dragon progeny who, in The War of the Shifting Sands, charges into Ahn'Qiraj beside Merithra and Arygos.

250660.name: The Baron
250660.blurb: Grand Marshal Garithos, who condemned Kael'thas; Sylvanas had him killed and the Forsaken stitched him back together.

2496.name: Baron Revilgaz
2496.blurb: In Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza he is won over by Riggle's tastyfish and agrees to a fishing tournament.

2784.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
2784.blurb: In the novel Tides of Darkness he defends Ironforge in the Second War; in The Shattering he is turned to diamond.

items.2188: Signed by the dwarf king who defended Ironforge in the Second War and joined the Alliance of Lordaeron.

332.name: Master Mathias Shaw
332.blurb: SI:7's spymaster, who in the short story Blood of Our Fathers helps search for the missing King Varian.

11878.name: Nathanos Blightcaller
11878.blurb: In the novel Before the Storm he is Sylvanas's champion and bodyguard; in Shadows Rising he fails to kill Bwonsamdi.

15192.name: Anachronos
15192.blurb: Bronze dragon who, in The War of the Shifting Sands, calls the other dragonflights against the qiraji.

344.name: Magistrate Solomon
344.blurb: In the novel Traveler he declares Greydon Thorne dead so that Ceya Northbrooke can marry Robb Glade.

7583.name: Sprinkle
7583.blurb: In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path she smuggles Aramar Thorne's companions into Gadgetzan hidden in her caravan.

1938.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938.blurb: One of the randomly named enemy archmage heroes who oppose Arthas outside Dalaran while Kel'Thuzad summons Archimonde.

240.name: Marshal Dughan
240.blurb: In the novel Stormrage the Emerald Nightmare gives him a dream of a failed kobold mission in Jasperlode Mine.

4501.name: Draz'Zilb
4501.blurb: Stonemaul ogre present in the ogre village when Rexxar arrives to ask the ogres for their aid.

4630.name: Pozzik
4630.blurb: In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path he officiates the Annual Boat Race that he co-founded with Fizzle Brassbolts.

3453.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453.blurb: In the novel Night of the Dragon he provides boat transport to Velinde Starsong and later to the draenei Iridi.

3057.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057.blurb: Tauren chieftain who tells Thrall of the Oracle and fights at his side; Rexxar must win his aid in Old Hatreds.

15380.name: Arygos
15380.blurb: Blue dragon who, in The War of the Shifting Sands, flies into Ahn'Qiraj with Merithra and Caelestrasz.

253957.name: Muln Earthfury
253957.blurb: In Thrall: Twilight of the Aspects the Earthen Ring shaman worries about Thrall, then helps rescue him.

9598.name: Arei
9598.blurb: In the novel Stormrage the Ancient of War fights the Emerald Nightmare from within the Dream and leads Broll to Zaetar.

10824.name: Ranger Lord Hawkspear
10824.blurb: In the novel World of Warcraft: Sylvanas he leads Quel'Lithien Lodge's hunters and probes Lireesa Windrunner's slaying.

15341.name: General Rajaxx
15341.blurb: In The War of the Shifting Sands he leads the qiraji and silithid against the night elves and kills Valstann Staghelm.

4968.name: Lady Jaina Proudmoore
4968.blurb: Sorceress hero at Arthas's side, later leader of the human survivors who allies with Thrall against Archimonde.

items.6757: Her own ring: the sorceress who stood with Arthas, then led the human survivors and allied with Thrall.
items.18642: Her signature: the sorceress who stood with Arthas, then led the human survivors and allied with Thrall.

2055.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
2055.blurb: In the novel Arthas: Rise of the Lich King he shows Sylvanas the New Plague by making two prisoners drink it.

10182.name: Rexxar
10182.blurb: Beastmaster hero of the Horde, the Mok'nathal who, with his bear Misha, helps Thrall secure Durotar.

10813.name: Balnazzar
10813.blurb: The dreadlord who seized Lordaeron's capital from Arthas with his brothers, then lost it to Sylvanas.

items.13250: His head: the dreadlord who seized Lordaeron's capital from Arthas with his brothers, then lost it to Sylvanas.

1156.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
1156.blurb: In the novella Quest for Pandaria she tells the dwarf Baenan of her longing for her estranged husband Talithar.

3977.name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
3977.blurb: Scarlet Crusade commander and enemy of the Forsaken; in the short story We Ride Forth she rides with the Four Horsemen.

2543.name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
2543.blurb: Council of Six archmage; one of the randomly named enemy archmage heroes who oppose Arthas outside Dalaran.

3520.name: Ol' Emma
3520.blurb: In the novel Before the Storm she searches among the Forsaken for her sons, and Anduin flies her to safety.

2707.name: Shadra
2707.blurb: In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path the spider loa refuses to claim the captives the Sandfury trolls would sacrifice.

2918.name: Advisor Belgrum
2918.blurb: In the novel The Shattering he helps decipher the Ulduar tablet, then steps up in Ironforge after Magni is petrified.

482.name: Elling Trias
482.blurb: In the audio short story The Tipping Point he meets Mathias Shaw in his cellar to plan protecting SI:7's informants.

4488.name: Parqual Fintallas
4488.blurb: In the novel Before the Storm he is a Forsaken historian and Desolate Council member, reunited with his daughter Philia.

7267.name: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
7267.blurb: In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path he helps summon the loa Kimbul, Shadra and Mueh'zala with his prisoners' blood.

5709.name: Shade of Eranikus
5709.blurb: In the novel Stormrage he first refuses to help, then carries Tyrande and Broll and sacrifices himself for Ysera.

2993.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993.blurb: Cairne's son, kidnapped by centaur and rescued by Rexxar; in Stormrage he leads the tauren against the Nightmare.

10540.name: Vol'jin
10540.blurb: Darkspear witch doctor who made Rexxar and friends spirit wyverns; in The Judgment he is tested at First Home.

4949.name: Thrall
4949.blurb: The orc Far Seer who led the Horde to Kalimdor, allied with Jaina against Archimonde and founded Durotar.

3144.name: Eitrigg
3144.blurb: In the novel Of Blood and Honor this Blackrock orc is saved from execution in Stratholme and joins Thrall's New Horde.

8929.name: Princess Moira Bronzebeard
8929.blurb: In the novel The Shattering she returns to Ironforge with her infant son to claim the throne; Varian spares her.

3660.name: Athrikus Narassin
3660.blurb: His Ring of Power's item text says he coveted the Well of Eternity and was left imbued with demonic powers.

3188.name: Master Gadrin
3188.blurb: In the short story The Judgment he mentors Vol'jin and Zalazane, then confirms the death of Sen'jin after First Home.

15077.name: Riggle Bassbait
15077.blurb: In Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza he wins over Baron Revilgaz with tastyfish and gets his tournament.

5144.name: Bink
5144.blurb: In the novel The Shattering the gnome mage and Dink's sister is caught by Dark Iron guards at Moira's arrival.

7937.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937.blurb: In the short story Cut Short he leads the gnomes to retake Gnomeregan and cuts Thermaplugg in half with his own trap.

4046.name: Magatha Grimtotem
4046.blurb: In the novel The Shattering she poisons Gorehowl so Garrosh can kill Cairne, then has her tribe attack Thunder Bluff.

10440.name: Baron Rivendare
10440.blurb: Cult of the Damned traitor who tortured captive soldiers in the Capital City sewers; Garek kills him in Stratholme.

items.13251: His head: the cult champion killed by Garek Bandarion in his Stratholme slaughterhouse.

2425.name: Varimathras
2425.blurb: Dreadlord hero, one of three brothers ruling Lordaeron, who secretly made a deal with Sylvanas to overthrow Arthas.
